items.title: Bill Watrous interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, March 26, 1999
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] My name is Monk Rowe... [INTERVIEWEE] Thank you, Monk. ... [INTERVIEWER] It’s been a great pleasure doing some playing with you

ctx.x: My name is Monk Rowe and we are filming today at Hamilton College for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive. I’m absolutely thrilled to have Bill Watrous with me today, who I can personally testify is one hell of a trombone player.
Welcome. It’s been a great pleasure doing some playing with you, and having your name with the jazz festival tomorrow is a real plus. So you are a son of a trombone player I read.
